designs.label: ASL Wood - Long barn (2 hex)
designs.prompt:
Use case: production game sprite. Generate ONE original wood building design inspired by the architecture in image 1, shown in six orientations. Image 1 is a SHAPE INSPIRATION reference from ASL board 1: study connected angular wings, long barns, stepped roof plans. Do not copy labels, hexes, ground, roads, colors or other terrain. Image 2 is the required GAME ART STYLE reference: detailed hand-painted orthographic roof textures, dark crisp eaves, narrow wall strips, small scale tabletop tactical art. Use its LEFT brown timber material example.
Design: one continuous narrow rectangular timber barn, long vertical ridge, unequal brown shingle panels, a short lower lean-to attached to its RIGHT side near the TOP end, small gabled loading porch at the BOTTOM end; asymmetric connected silhouette, roof aspect ratio approximately 1:2.4. This is one connected 2-hex building, not a group of detached houses. ALL roofs including wings, porches and lean-tos must be natural medium brown timber/shingles, with dark wooden walls. No red/orange tile roofs and no grey roofs.
Composition: exactly SIX views of this SAME building in an evenly spaced 3-column by 2-row sprite sheet on a genuinely transparent background. Reading order top row 0, 60, 120 degrees; bottom row 180, 240, 300 degrees. At zero degrees the main long ridge is straight VERTICAL. Subsequent angles are exact clockwise rotations: 60 degrees long axis runs upper-right to lower-left; 120 degrees upper-left to lower-right. Preserve the exact footprint shape, proportions, wing positions, notches, chimney count and roof details across all six rotations. Consistent common scale; generous empty transparent space around each complete silhouette. Each building centered within its own cell and contained entirely inside it, no touching neighboring views. Orthographic TOP DOWN, camera exactly overhead, no perspective or isometric walls.
Transparent alpha background and courtyard notches. Only the six roof-and-narrow-wall sprites. No text, labels, grids, decorative border, backdrop, shadow on the ground, trees, scenery, furniture or characters. Do not include any extra buildings.
